cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Use the Right Vocabulary
cards.instruction: Perform belonging by using official language confidently, adjusting each term whenever someone reveals what it actually means.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. As your newest club member, I'd like to second the minutes. They took ages.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You second a motion. I'm proposing we approve the minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then I second your motion. Unanimously.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Unanimous means everyone agrees. Ruth hasn't voted.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Seconded, with unanimity pending Ruth. Shall I put that in our minutes?

mechanism: A uses newly corrected club terms to supervise the meeting as though already its procedural expert.
confusable: D187 contests authority sources; D186 specifically revises the official vocabulary to perform membership.
comparison: Public meeting voice and a pending voter differ from private document checking.
seedUse: Keep second/motion/unanimity corrections; make A direct B with each newly adopted meaning.
